What degree will I earn?

The 10K Degree Completion Program offers a swift and cost-effective route to obtaining a Bachelor of Science in Leadership Studies or a Bachelor of Arts in University Studies. We recognize that each student is unique, which is why we offer a diverse array of options to customize their educational journey according to their passions and professional aspirations. Our flexible and dynamic pathway enables the utilization of transfer credits that might otherwise remain unused in alternative majors.

Our core curriculum is meticulously crafted for interdisciplinary students, fostering the development of knowledge, skills, and abilities to address global concerns, solve complex problems, and engage with contemporary social issues from multiple perspectives.

Increase Your Earning Potential with a Flexible, Accelerated Bachelor's Degree Program

On average, graduates with a bachelor's degree earn $22,000 more per year than high school graduates, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The Interdisciplinary Studies program offers a Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree, that provides students with a diverse range of options to tailor their education to their interests and career goals.

The Leadership Studies Bachelor of Science (BS) degree further enhances this advantage by offering a dynamic and customizable pathway. Our core curriculum is meticulously crafted for interdisciplinary students, fostering the development of knowledge, skills, and abilities to address global concerns, solve complex problems, and engage with contemporary social issues from multiple perspectives.

Graduates of our $10K Degree Completion Program possess the tools and skills for success across various fields, including business, education, government, computing applications, healthcare, and more. We understand that students pursuing degrees in general studies require unique career paths, necessitating a program of study that offers flexibility. With Texas Tech's flexible, accelerated bachelor's degree, you can fully explore and integrate customizable areas of study, ensuring that your education aligns seamlessly with your career goals and future plans. Join us in embracing adaptability and unlocking a broad skill set that positions you for success in today's dynamic job market.

The $10K Degree Completion Program is Designed to help Adult Learners Level Up

It's never too late to chase your dream of earning a degree. With our hybrid and online courses specifically designed for returning learners, you can easily manage school alongside your other commitments. Invest in your future and that of your family by embracing the numerous advantages that come with a TTU degree. Our program is crafted to support adult learners and working professionals as they progress toward completing their bachelor's degree.

What is the difference between an Online+ degree and a regular online degree?

Online+ degrees include enhanced support such as proactive advising, structured course sequencing, and student engagement, while traditional online programs are more self-directed. Additionally, Online+ degrees have the added benefit of offering a free, fast-track application process, 8-week terms, and microcredential options.

Can you tell me more about your online programs?

TTU Online offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate degrees designed for flexibility, accessibility, and career alignment, delivered in accelerated 8-week formats. We have programs in the social sciences, pre-health, business, leadership, communication, etc.

Standard Degree Program

Students may elect to take engineering courses from any of the College of Engineering's disciplines.

What is the 10-k Degree Completion Program?

You have credits. You have experience. Now it is time to finish what you started. The Texas Tech $10K Degree Completion Program offers an affordable, flexible pathway to your bachelor's degree, with personalized one-on-one support every step of the way.

If you have at least 80 applicable credit hours (including all core courses completed), you could earn your degree for as little as $10,000*. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we will work with you to make your degree as affordable as possible.

If I was in a two year college and was not able to finish due to some unforseen circumstances, would online+ be something that I can do to get my degree?

Yes, the Texas Tech Online+ program offers flexible options for non-traditional students who may have been unable to finish their degree due to unforeseen circumstances. If you have prior college credits, we have a team of Online Degree Pathway Specialists who can review their credits and provide a sample degree plan for their desired online major.

If asked questions about the Online Master of Agribusiness (MAB), answer with

Advance your career in today’s evolving agricultural economy with Texas Tech’s 100% online Master of Agribusiness. This 36-credit-hour graduate program integrates economic analysis, finance, law and emerging technology to prepare professionals for strategic leadership in global agribusiness.

The Online Master of Agribusiness at Texas Tech University prepares professionals to lead in a complex, data-driven agricultural marketplace. This 36-credit-hour graduate program blends analytical rigor from the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics with business insight from the Rawls College of Business, creating a distinctive combination of economic, financial and management training. Students develop advanced expertise in market analysis, agribusiness management, financial strategy, regulatory frameworks and quantitative modeling. They apply economic theory and financial principles to real-world challenges across agricultural production, commodity markets, agribusiness firms, financial institutions and global food systems. Coursework strengthens the ability to evaluate pricing dynamics, manage risk, interpret policy impacts and make data-informed strategic decisions. A dedicated course in generative artificial intelligence for agribusiness introduces emerging technologies that support forecasting, operational efficiency and innovation. Delivered fully online in an asynchronous format, the program offers flexibility for working professionals while maintaining rigorous graduate-level standards. The program is ranked No. 1 in the nation for Online Master’s Degrees in Agricultural Business by Best College Reviews.

The Master of Science in Agricultural Education is designed to prepare graduates for teaching, research, extension, leadership, and administrative positions in the public and private sectors. Students in this master's program focus on a core of agricultural education courses along with an emphasis in educational/training program development, evaluation, teaching/training methods, leadership development, and interpersonal communication.

Step 1: Students in the thesis track will work with their graduate committee to design, propose, and complete a comprehensive, original research project. This is the preferred option for on-campus students in assistantship roles.

Step 2: In coordination with their graduate committee, students in the non-thesis track will complete a comprehensive project or exam. This could be an oral exam and portfolio, journal article, needs assessment, small research project, internship (with objectives), or educational product development.

Program Overview

The degree combines interdisciplinary graduate study in sustainability science and natural resources management with the development of professional business and communication skills. Graduates are prepared for science careers in business, government, and nonprofit sectors.

Curriculum

The curriculum for the Master of Engineering program consists of 30 semester credit hours of coordinated graduate level course work. No more than 12 credit hours (4 courses) can be taken in any single engineering discipline, e.g., Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.

The program allows up to six hours of course work to be taken outside of engineering, upon the approval of the graduate advisor.

Every candidate for a master's degree is required to pass a final comprehensive examination.In the final semester, students must take the Master’s report course (ENGR6330) which serves as their comprehensive exam requirement for graduation.

Transfer of Courses

Students may be permitted to transfer up to six credit hours of relevant engineering coursework from another university graduate program upon approval of the Graduate School. All transfer courses are subject to the same time limitations as courses taken in the program (a maximum of six years from the first course in the plan of study until graduation).

Are there any limitations on transfer credits?

Yes, limits depend on the degree applicability towards a chosen program and residency requirements.

If asked questions about the Online Doctor of Education in Agricultural Education, answer with

The joint Ed.D. program (Doc@Distance) previously provided by Texas Tech University and Texas A&M University will not admit a cohort in 2019. This is a result of recent graduate program reviews at both universities and reflection on the future of the program.

If you are interested in pursuing a doctoral graduate degree via distance, you can still do so at Texas Tech University with the Doctor of Education in agricultural education degree program.

The Doctor of Education in agricultural education degree program builds on previous undergraduate and graduate courses along with their life experiences (including three years of related work experiences). It is designed to develop independent and critical thinking. Emphasis is placed on selecting courses and experiences that lead to a thorough and comprehensive knowledge of agricultural education and/or agricultural communications, a supporting field, and methods of research and statistics.

Step 1: This degree program requires a minimum of 72 semester hours of graduate coursework beyond the baccalaureate degree along with the development of a dissertation.

Step 2: At or near the end of coursework, the student will take a qualifying written examination consisting of eight hours for Agricultural Education, four hours for Research, Evaluation, and Statistics; and four hours for the Supporting Field.

Step 3: No more than one week after the written examination, the student will take an oral qualifying examination. Both of these examinations will be administered by the student's advisory committee (consisting of at least three members of the graduate faculty).

Step 4: After completion of the dissertation, the student will present and defend a dissertation.

Please note that this program is offered by main campus and is 100% Online - Asynchronous

Introduction

We thank you for your interest in our Graduate Online+ Program. Below you will find some additional information about the Graduate Online+ program Structure & Format. If you have any questions, please feel free to submit a support request or contact us at 806-742-6441.

Curriculum & Program Requirements

Step 1: Core Courses:

5 essential graduate courses from both Biological Sciences and Natural Resources Management.

Step 1: Electives:

Choose 5 approved graduate courses from across the university.

Step 1: Professional Business Skills:

Develop written and oral communication and business skills through a tuition-free, self-paced online curriculum or by earning the Graduate Certificate in Essentials of Business from the Rawls College of Business.

Step 1: Internships:

Gain hands-on experience through internships in business, government, or non-profits, culminating in a final project documenting your growth in the profession.

Step 1: Portfolio:

Prepare and defend a comprehensive student portfolio demonstrating your career development through your PSM experiences.

Application Deadlines

Admissions are rolling. US-based students should apply a minimum of 45 days prior to preferred start date.

If you would like to apply after that date, please contact Associate Dean Coy Callison (coy.callison@ttu.edu) for direction. The College of Media & Communication will do its best to admit qualified applicants up to the start of the semester. International students need to have materials in much earlier due to a more lengthy verification process.

Advance your career in today’s evolving agricultural economy with Texas Tech’s 100% online Master of Agribusiness. This 36-credit-hour graduate program integrates economic analysis, finance, law and emerging technology to prepare professionals for strategic leadership in global agribusiness.

The Online Master of Agribusiness at Texas Tech University prepares professionals to lead in a complex, data-driven agricultural marketplace. This 36-credit-hour graduate program blends analytical rigor from the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics with business insight from the Rawls College of Business, creating a distinctive combination of economic, financial and management training. Students develop advanced expertise in market analysis, agribusiness management, financial strategy, regulatory frameworks and quantitative modeling. They apply economic theory and financial principles to real-world challenges across agricultural production, commodity markets, agribusiness firms, financial institutions and global food systems. Coursework strengthens the ability to evaluate pricing dynamics, manage risk, interpret policy impacts and make data-informed strategic decisions. A dedicated course in generative artificial intelligence for agribusiness introduces emerging technologies that support forecasting, operational efficiency and innovation. Delivered fully online in an asynchronous format, the program offers flexibility for working professionals while maintaining rigorous graduate-level standards.
